verses.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up, Let Israel now say,

segments.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up,

verses.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.

segments.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up:
Yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.text: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.

segments.text: The plowers plowed upon my back;

verses.text: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

segments.text: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.text: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.

segments.text: Let them be put to shame and turned backward,

verses.text: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it groweth up;

segments.text: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops,
Which withereth before it groweth up;

verses.text: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves, his bosom:

segments.text: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand,
Nor he that bindeth sheaves, his bosom:

verses.text: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; We bless you in the name of Jehovah.

segments.text: Neither do they that go by say,
The blessing of Jehovah be upon you;
We bless you in the name of Jehovah.
